params.prompt: Create an immaculate premium collector card print. Reproduce the exact real cat in Image one as the central figure, preserving its face markings, narrow forward facing head, short natural fur and slim upright torso. Its viewer left foreleg hangs lower beside the body, while its viewer right forepaw bends at chest level. Retain the original gray and white coat pattern, natural eye shape, small nose, standing hind feet and quiet expression. Image two supplies only the matching thin rounded frame materials: pale ivory ceramic, fine ribbed silver rails and a restrained warm wood accent. Surround the source faithful cat with a single continuous finished ivory material field and subtle source inspired floor grain. Keep the full rounded printed edge smooth and refined, the composition straight on, the materials crisp and the illumination soft and even. The cat is the sole hero. The finished image contains no caption, lettering, labels, numbers or writing panels.
